title: Genome Sequence of Bacillus altitudinis HH-03 Isolated from Dairy Pipeline
content: In this study, Bacillus altitudinis HH-03 was isolated from a dairy pipeline and its genomic information was obtained by performing sequencing. The genome size of strain HH-03 was 3.85 Mbp with a GC content of 41.2%. Based on the annotation procedure, 4,010 protein-coding genes were identified. The genomic information of strain HH-03 will be helpful for the development of clean-in-place processes.
